propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 escapes arrows inside code spans, deletes HTML comments including rebar reconciler markers, and corrupts `-->` delimiters; a post-render code-preservation check mitigates by falling back to original Markdown if code fragments do not appear verbatim in output

A two-phase segmenting renderer with locked blocks (fences, HTML comments, code) and classification rules (safe/table/verbatim/prose) must render only CommonMark-safe units through pandoc while preserving code, tables, HTML comments, and arrows as exact bytes

A deterministic 178-body corpus (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) with pinned cardinality and stratum targets must achieve >=0.90 body ratio and >=0.95 character ratio of eligible units that actually change, with zero code fragments lost and zero HTML comments deleted

Inline-Jira classification must split unambiguous wiki markers ({{monospace}}, [label|target], {color:name}) from ambiguous CommonMark forms (*strong*, _emphasis_) to prevent re-rendering cycles; five-pass stability must reach 0 drifting bodies from an initial 37

Pypandoc-binary 1.15 bundling pandoc 3.6.1 must be pinned exactly via an optional `wiki` extra; real binary availability must gate via hard import and version assertion on Linux/macOS with identity fallback on other platforms

Missing pandoc, conversion failure, and preservation failure must return exact original unit with content-free fallback events (wiki_render_fallback with reason pandoc_absent/conversion_failure/preservation_failure) and never log body content
